no one is obliged to do more than he can phrase

modern

Traupman 257

Ultrā posse nēmō obligātur.

A legal maxim in this shape; we have found no ancient source for its wording. The Digest has the rule in Celsus’s words (below).

Other words

  • Inpossibilium nūlla obligātiō est.

    also used · classical · Dig. 50.17.185 (Celsus)

    Literally “there is no obligation to do impossible things”: one of the rules of law at the end of the Digest.
